prompts.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay based on the graph below. You should start your essay with a brief description of the graph and comment on China's achievements in urbanization. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
outline: 第 1 段｜描述图表趋势：开头一句总述折线整体走向，再用起止数据佐证，落实 a brief description of the graph。
第 2 段｜评论成就与原因：承接图表转入评论，分析中国城镇化成就的推动因素与积极意义，落实 comment on China's achievements in urbanization，篇幅最大。
第 3 段｜总结与展望：重申折线所反映的巨大成就，对未来作简短展望，收束全文，不引入新论点。
points: 描述趋势与起止数据：第一部分用一两句概括折线走向并佐证：折线从1980年的19.39%开始，逐年增长，到2019年达到60.6%，只取起止两点，不逐年罗列。
成就背后的推动因素：评论第一层：分析成就的原因——持续的经济增长带来城市就业岗位，前瞻性的政府政策与基础设施建设推动人口和产业向城镇转移。
城镇化的积极意义：评论第二层：成就的意义——反映国家现代化、提高民众生活水平、促进区域协调发展，并自然收束到对未来的展望。
facts: 核心任务｜先描图后评论：本题要写一篇基于图表的短文：先用一两句话概括图表信息，再重点评论中国城镇化取得的成就。要求原文 You should start your essay with a brief description of the graph and comment on China's achievements in urbanization 把'描述'和'评论'两个任务并列钉死，缺一不可，且评论是重头。
读者 · 语域｜面向阅卷人的正式书面语：本题是图表说明兼议论性短文，没有具体收信人，面向阅卷人用正式书面语即可：不用口语缩写、不写 you know 这类插入语，保持客观陈述与分析的语气。无需强行加称呼或署名，那会画蛇添足。
配图要读出｜城镇化率持续攀升：本图核心是一条持续上升的折线：折线从1980年的19.39%开始，逐年增长，到2019年达到60.6%。可写点是起点 1980年: 19.39% 与终点 2019年: 60.6% 之间的巨大落差，以及 2000 年后增速明显加快这一趋势变化。
中心立意｜城镇化成就巨大：本篇中心：图中城镇化率四十年间的大幅攀升，正是中国城镇化建设取得巨大成就的缩影，其背后有经济增长、政策推动等多重力量。这直接回应 comment on China's achievements in urbanization 的要求。
rubric: 内容切题｜描述评论都要写：本题两个任务缺一不可：a brief description of the graph 和 comment on China's achievements in urbanization。最易失分处是评论部分被漏写或只有一句空话。
结构连贯｜描述评论三七开：本题描述约占三分之一、评论约占三分之二；要有一句过渡（如 Behind this rapid urbanization …）把图表事实引向评论，别描述完直接跳到结尾。
语言准确｜趋势词与数值别说反：本题要用 rose / climbed / increased 等上升类动词，别误用下降词；数值须与图一致，起点 19.39%、终点 60.6% 不能抄反或错位。
字数格式｜落在规定区间内：本题要求 at least 150 words but no more than 200 words，既不能不足也不能超；正文分三段、层次分明，别写成一大坨不分段。
pitfalls: 逐年罗列数字：反面示例：In 1980 it was 19.39%, in 1985 it was 23.71%, in 1990 it was 26.41%, in 1995 it was 29.04%, and so on.（把每个点念一遍，却没有一句趋势概括）。改成：The urbanization rate rose steadily, climbing from 19.39% in 1980 to 60.6% in 2019.

只描述不评论：反面示例：整篇只写折线怎么上升、各年数值多少，结尾一句 So urbanization increased a lot. 就收尾，完全没有评论。改成：补一段分析——Behind this growth lie sustained economic development and supportive government policies, which have greatly improved people's living standards.
描述占满评论被挤：反面示例：用一百多词细细描述每个年份的数字，只剩一句 China has done a good job. 当作评论。改成：把描述压缩成两三句，腾出篇幅展开成就的原因与积极意义两层分析。
数值单位说反：反面示例：The number of urban people fell to 60.6 million in 2019.（把上升说成 fell，又把百分比 60.6% 误当成 million 人数）。改成：The urbanization rate rose to 60.6% in 2019.
model: As is vividly shown in the line graph above, the degree of urbanization in China rose steadily and remarkably over nearly four decades. Specifically, the proportion of urban population climbed from a mere 19.39% in 1980 to a striking 60.6% in 2019, tripling within the period, with the growth becoming especially rapid after the year 2000.

Behind this rapid urbanization lie China's tremendous achievements. To begin with, decades of sustained economic growth created vast job opportunities in cities, drawing hundreds of millions of rural residents into urban areas. Moreover, forward-looking government policies and large-scale infrastructure construction accelerated the transfer of population and industries from the countryside to towns. Such progress not only reflects the modernization of the nation but also greatly improves people's living standards and promotes balanced regional development.

In conclusion, the impressive climb of the urbanization curve mirrors the remarkable strides China has made. If this momentum is sustained wisely, the country will surely embrace an even brighter and more prosperous future.
modelTranslation: 如上方折线图所生动展示的，1980 至 2019 近四十年间，中国的城镇化率稳步而显著地上升。具体而言，城镇人口所占的比例从 1980 年区区的 19.39% 攀升至 2019 年惊人的 60.6%，在此期间翻了两番，且 2000 年之后增长尤为迅猛。
这种快速城镇化的背后，是中国取得的巨大成就。首先，数十年持续的经济增长在城市创造了大量就业机会，吸引数以亿计的农村居民进入城镇。此外，具有前瞻性的政府政策和大规模的基础设施建设，加快了人口和产业由乡村向城镇的转移。这样的进步不仅体现了国家的现代化，也极大地提高了民众的生活水平、促进了区域协调发展。
总之，城镇化曲线那令人瞩目的攀升，正是中国所取得的非凡成就的写照。倘若这一势头得以明智地延续，国家必将迎来更加光明、更加繁荣的未来。
breakdown: 第 1 段｜总述加起止数据：。本段用 As is vividly shown … 一句总述趋势，再用 climbed from a mere 19.39% in 1980 to a striking 60.6% in 2019 只取起止两点，兑现了描述段'总述趋势再取点佐证'的方法，没有逐年罗列数字。
第 2 段｜过渡加原因加意义：。本段以 Behind this rapid urbanization lie … 完成从描述到评论的过渡，用 To begin with / Moreover 铺开两条原因，再用 not only … but also … 抬出意义，落实了评论段的展开步骤，篇幅上是全文重头。
第 3 段｜重申加展望：。本段用 In conclusion 引出，以 the urbanization curve mirrors the remarkable strides 重申中心，再用 If this momentum is sustained … 展望收尾，呼应立意且不引入新论点。

prompts.label: Part I · 写作
directions: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay based on the chart below. You should start your essay with a brief description of the chart and comment on China's achievements in higher education . You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
prompts.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay based on the chart below. You should start your essay with a brief description of the chart and comment on China's achievements in higher education . You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
outline: 第 1 段｜简要描述图表趋势：落实 start your essay with a brief description of the chart：一两句先点明图表主题与整体上升趋势，再用起点、终点和一两个节点数据佐证。
第 2 段｜评论高教成就：用一句概括句过渡到 comment on 部分，从扩招惠及大众、壮大人才库两方面分析 achievements in higher education。
第 3 段｜收束呼应主题：重申上升趋势的意义、表达展望，收尾并把全文控制在 at least 150 words but no more than 200 words 的区间内。
points: 描述点：整体上升大趋势：客观转述数据走向：从 1990年: 3.4% 到 2019年: 51.6% 一路攀升，翻了约十五倍，挑两三个节点佐证即可，不逐年罗列。
评论一：扩招惠及普通家庭：入学率飙升背后是高校大规模扩招，让普通家庭的孩子也能迈进大学校门——这是 comment on 部分最实在的一个成就。
评论二：人才储备与国家竞争力：入学率提升意味着更庞大的技能人才库，为经济输送工程师、医生、研究者，从而增强国家竞争力，紧扣 achievements in higher education。
facts: 核心任务｜先描述图表，再评价高教成就：这句 Directions 里藏着两个必做动作：先 start your essay with a brief description of the chart（客观描述图表走向），再 comment on 中国的 achievements in higher education（评价高教成就）。两件事缺一不可——只描述不评论、或只评论不描述，都会直接漏掉指令要求的任务点、内容分大打折扣。
读者 · 语域｜面向阅卷人的正式书面语：本题是图表作文，没有具体收信人—— write an essay 面向的其实是阅卷老师，因此全程用正式书面语：以第三人称客观陈述数据，评论段可用 In my view 谨慎带出个人看法，但不要用 gonna、kids 之类口语缩写或俚语，也别写成聊天口吻。

配图要读出｜折线图：毛入学率三十年一路飙升：配图是一张折线图 Gross enrolment ratio in higher education in China (1990 - 2019)，横轴是年份、纵轴是毛入学率。最该抓的是整体飙升的大趋势：从 1990年: 3.4% 一路爬到 2019年: 51.6%，中间可挑 2000年: 11%、2012年: 30% 这两个节点当证据，而不是把每一年的数字都罗列出来。
中心立意｜毛入学率飙升印证高教巨大成就：中心一句话：中国高等教育毛入学率近三十年持续飙升，这组数字正是 achievements in higher education 的缩影。全篇既要描述这条上升曲线，也要把它读成成就的证据。
rubric: 内容切题｜描述与评论两个任务都要有：本题两个采分动作缺一不可： start your essay with a brief description of the chart 与 comment on 中国的 achievements in higher education。最易失分处就是只写了其中一个。
结构连贯｜用概括句从描述过渡到评论：本题最考验衔接的地方是从数据描述转到评论，务必用一句概括句（如 Behind these figures lie...）承上启下，别让"评论"突兀地砸出来。
语言准确｜描述数据的动词与介词要准：本题密集出现趋势描述，rise to / climb from...to / reach + 数字这类搭配要用准；避免 the number rise（主谓不一致）、up to 与 reach 混用这类硬伤。
字数格式｜卡进150到200词的硬区间：本题硬性要求 at least 150 words but no more than 200 words，写太短或超过上限都会扣分；用节点数据而非逐年罗列，正好帮你把篇幅控制在区间内。
pitfalls: 只描述数据不评论：反面示例：全篇只写 The ratio was 3.4% in 1990, 11% in 2000, 30% in 2012, and 51.6% in 2019.（从头念到尾，只有数字没有一句评价）。修正：在描述之后另起一段评论，如 These rising figures reflect the remarkable achievements China has made in higher education, especially the expansion of university enrolment.

逐年罗列数据：反面示例：In 1990 it was 3.4%, in 1995 it was 6.86%, in 2000 it was 11%, in 2001 it was 13.3%...（把二十多个数据全念一遍）。修正：The figure climbed steadily from 3.4% in 1990 to 51.6% in 2019, roughly fifteen times the initial level.

空泛喊口号不结合图：反面示例：Education is very important. Our country is becoming stronger and better every day.（正确的废话，与图表毫无关联）。修正：The jump from 3.4% to 51.6% shows how greatly higher education has expanded, giving far more young people access to college.
中式英语硬译趋势：反面示例：The number rise very high and go up to fifty-one point six percent.（时态、主谓、搭配全错）。修正：The figure rose sharply and reached 51.6% in 2019.
model: The line chart illustrates the changes in the gross enrolment ratio in higher education in China from 1990 to 2019. As is clearly shown, the figure witnessed a steady and remarkable upward trend over these three decades. In 1990, only 3.4% of the eligible population entered higher education. This proportion climbed steadily, passing 11% in 2000 and 30% in 2012, before finally reaching 51.6% in 2019, roughly fifteen times the initial level.

Behind these figures lie China's impressive achievements in higher education. First, the dramatic rise reflects the massive expansion of university enrolment, which has opened the door of college to millions of ordinary families. Moreover, the higher enrolment ratio means a far larger pool of skilled talent, supplying the economy with engineers, doctors and researchers. In my view, such progress not only improves individual prospects but also strengthens the nation's competitiveness.

In conclusion, the steady climb of the enrolment ratio speaks volumes about how far Chinese higher education has advanced, and I firmly believe this positive momentum will continue in the years ahead.
modelTranslation: 这张折线图展示了1990年至2019年中国高等教育毛入学率的变化。如图所清晰显示的，在这三十年间该数字呈现出稳步而显著的上升趋势。1990年，只有3.4%的适龄人口进入高等教育。这一比例稳步攀升，2000年越过11%，2012年达到30%，最终在2019年升至51.6%，约为最初水平的十五倍。
这些数字背后是中国在高等教育方面令人瞩目的成就。首先，这一急剧上升反映了高校招生规模的大幅扩张，让千百万普通家庭的孩子得以迈进大学校门。此外，更高的入学率意味着更为庞大的技能人才库，为经济输送工程师、医生和研究人员。在我看来，这样的进步不仅改善了个人前景，也增强了国家的竞争力。
总而言之，入学率的稳步攀升有力地说明了中国高等教育已经走得多远，我坚信这一积极势头将在未来持续下去。
breakdown: 第 1 段｜总趋势领起再上数据：。首句 The line chart illustrates the changes... 套用了"亮出图表主题"句架，完成"简要描述"的第一步；As is clearly shown... a steady and remarkable upward trend 先给整体结论，再用 3.4%、11% in 2000、30% in 2012、51.6% 挑点佐证，最后一句 roughly fifteen times 点出翻倍幅度——描述客观、不逐年罗列，落实了 outline 第一段"简要描述图表趋势"。

第 2 段｜概括句过渡后分点评论：。Behind these figures lie China's impressive achievements 用一句概括句把话题从数字接到成就，承上启下；First... reflects the massive expansion of university enrolment 与 Moreover... a far larger pool of skilled talent 分两点写扩招与人才，每点都拴回图表数据；In my view... not only... but also 谨慎表态，兑现 outline 第二段的评论任务。

第 3 段｜重申核心并展望收尾：。In conclusion, the steady climb... speaks volumes about how far Chinese higher education has advanced 换一种说法重申"上升=成就"这一核心，呼应主题；and I firmly believe this positive momentum will continue 以展望收束，不引入新论点，对应 outline 第三段"收束呼应主题"。

prompts.label: Part I · 写作
directions: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay based on the chart below. You should start your essay with a brief description of the chart and comment on China's achievements in poverty alleviation. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
prompts.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay based on the chart below. You should start your essay with a brief description of the chart and comment on China's achievements in poverty alleviation. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
outline: 第 1 段｜描述图表趋势：引出图表，用一两句概括 start your essay with a brief description of the chart 所要求的整体下降走向与起止数据。
第 2 段｜评论之成因：过渡入评论，分析这一成就背后的成因：国家优先与针对性扶贫举措。
第 3 段｜评论之意义并收尾：升华成就的意义（民生改善、国际示范），并以一句表态结束全篇。
points: 描述要点：整体大幅下降：用一句话概括 清晰地展现了中国农村贫困人口数量和贫困发生率的下降趋势：两组数据从2012到2020年一路下滑，最终趋近于零。
评论角度一：成因：分析成就的原因——政府把脱贫列为国家优先事项，推出发展地方产业、异地搬迁、改善教育等有针对性的举措。
评论角度二：意义：分析成就的意义——极大改善了农村人口的民生，也为其他发展中国家的减贫提供了可借鉴的范例。
facts: 核心任务｜先描述图表再评论脱贫：本题要求写 an essay based on the chart below，并明确指令 start your essay with a brief description of the chart and comment on China's achievements in poverty alleviation。可见这是一道'双任务'题：先客观描述图表趋势，再就中国脱贫成就发表评论，两件事缺一不可，且顺序固定——先描述、后评论。
读者 · 语域｜面向阅卷人的正式书面语：这是一篇 an essay based on the chart below，没有具体收信人，读者就是阅卷老师。因此全程用正式的书面语、第三人称客观陈述为主，评论段可出现一次'In my view'表明立场，但不要用口语缩略或网络用语，也不必写称呼和落款。
配图要读出｜贫困人口与发生率双降到近零：配图标题为 Rural population in poverty，横轴 从2012年到2020年，图 清晰地展现了中国农村贫困人口数量和贫困发生率的下降趋势。可写的核心就两条：农村贫困人口从约98百万降到近0，贫困发生率从约10.2%降到约0%。抓住'起点—终点—双双趋近于零'即可，中间年份的具体数字不必写进作文。
中心立意｜脱贫成就源于举措意义重大：全篇的评论中心是：图表显示的农村贫困人口与 贫困发生率 双双趋近于零，是一项来之不易的巨大成就；它既源于政府有针对性的扶贫举措，也对民生改善和世界减贫具有重要示范意义。
rubric: 内容切题｜描述与评论都不能缺：本题双任务 start your essay with a brief description of the chart and comment on China's achievements in poverty alleviation 必须都覆盖，最易失分处是只描述数据、忘写评论。
结构连贯｜描述转评论要有桥：本题最容易在'描述段'与'评论段'之间断裂，需靠一个过渡句从图表自然转入对成因的分析，三段各承担一个功能、不混写。
语言准确｜脱贫与趋势词用准：本题应准确使用 poverty alleviation、decline / plunge、lift... out of poverty、account for 等表达；用 Not only has it... 这类倒装时务必写对语序。
字数格式｜守住区间并分段：本题要求 at least 150 words but no more than 200 words，需分段呈现描述与评论，且描述段不宜过长，把篇幅留给评论。
pitfalls: 通篇罗列数字无评论：反面示例：'In 2012 the poor population was 98 million. In 2013 it was 82 million. In 2014 it was 70 million...' 逐年抄数字、没有任何评论。改法：描述段压成一句总趋势，再加一段评论——'This remarkable decline results from the government's targeted poverty-relief measures and sets a valuable example for other countries.'
堆砌每个年份数据：反面示例：把2012到2020每一年的两组数字全写进去，描述段占了大半篇。改法：'The rural poor population dropped sharply from around 98 million in 2012 to nearly zero in 2020.' 一句带过整体走向即可。

评论只有赞美无论据：反面示例：'This is a great achievement. It is really wonderful and everyone should be proud.' 全是空泛赞美。改法：'This achievement stems from a series of targeted measures such as developing local industries and improving rural education.'
model: The chart clearly illustrates the striking decline of rural poverty in China from 2012 to 2020. During this period, the rural poor population plunged from around 98 million to nearly zero, while the incidence of poverty fell in parallel from about 10.2% to almost 0%. Based on official statistics, this downward trend remained remarkably steady throughout the whole period.

Several factors account for this remarkable achievement. Above all, the Chinese government made poverty alleviation a national priority and rolled out a series of targeted measures, such as developing local industries, relocating residents from harsh areas and improving education. These well-designed policies steadily lifted millions of people out of poverty.

The significance of this progress can hardly be overstated. Not only has it dramatically improved the livelihood of the rural population, but it also offers a valuable model for other developing nations still fighting poverty. In my view, such an accomplishment fully demonstrates what determination and effective governance can bring about.
modelTranslation: 这张图表清晰地展现了2012年至2020年中国农村贫困的惊人下降。在此期间，农村贫困人口从约9800万骤降至近乎为零，与此同时，贫困发生率也同步从约10.2%降至几乎为0%。基于官方统计数据，这一下降趋势在整个时期内保持得相当平稳。
促成这一非凡成就的因素有多个。首先，中国政府将脱贫列为国家优先事项，并推出了一系列有针对性的举措，例如发展地方产业、将居民从恶劣地区异地搬迁、改善教育等。这些精心设计的政策稳步地让数以百万计的人摆脱了贫困。
这一进步的意义怎么强调都不为过。它不仅极大地改善了农村人口的生活，也为其他仍在与贫困作斗争的发展中国家提供了宝贵的范例。在我看来，这样的成就充分展现了决心与有效治理所能带来的力量。
breakdown: 第 1 段｜一句趋势加起止值：。本段落实了'一句概括总趋势'：首句 'The chart clearly illustrates the striking decline of rural poverty' 套用'引出图表'句架点明主题与方向；接着用 'plunged from around 98 million to nearly zero, while the incidence of poverty fell in parallel from about 10.2% to almost 0%' 只交代首尾两端数据，中间年份全部略去，且全段无一句主观评价，严守描述段的边界。

第 2 段｜成因主句加实例回扣：。本段落实了'成因分点加实例'：'Several factors account for this remarkable achievement' 作过渡兼主句，'such as developing local industries, relocating residents... and improving education' 用实例撑起成因，末句 'These well-designed policies steadily lifted millions of people out of poverty' 把举措与结果回扣，评论有据不空喊。

第 3 段｜双层意义加表态收口：。本段落实了'升华意义收全篇'：'can hardly be overstated' 强调意义，'Not only has it... but it also...' 分'民生改善'与'国际示范'两层展开且用了部分倒装，末句 'In my view, such an accomplishment fully demonstrates...' 表态收尾，给全文一个明确落点。
prompts.paperTitle: 2021 年 6 月六级翻译与写作第 3 套

prompts.label: Part I · 写作
directions: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay related to the short passage given below. In your essay, you are to comment on the phenomenon described in the passage and suggest measures to address the issue. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words. Young people spend a lot of time on the Internet. However, they are sometimes unable to recognize false information on the Internet, judge the reliability of online information sources, or tell real news stories from fake ones.
prompts.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay related to the short passage given below. In your essay, you are to comment on the phenomenon described in the passage and suggest measures to address the issue. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words. Young people spend a lot of time on the Internet. However, they are sometimes unable to recognize false information on the Internet, judge the reliability of online information sources, or tell real news stories from fake ones.
outline: 第 1 段｜复述现象并评论：开篇用一两句概述现象、复述 passage 的 Young people spend a lot of time on the Internet 与其辨假困境，并点明这是一个值得严肃对待的问题。
第 2 段｜分析危害与成因：承接第一段，展开『为什么这是个问题』：被假信息误导的后果，以及年轻人为何格外脆弱，为下段对策铺垫必要性。
第 3 段｜分点对策加收尾：集中兑现 suggest measures to address the issue：按学校、平台、个人三个主体分点给出具体做法，末句升华收束。
points: 现象＋点明危害：第一个要点：复述现象并给出评论——年轻人耗在网上，却unable to recognize false information on the Internet，这种数字辨别力的缺失普遍且危险，值得严肃对待。这一点负责把 passage 现象说清楚并亮出『它是问题』的态度。
影响与成因分析：第二个要点：分析这一现象的后果与根源——被假新闻误导会让年轻人形成扭曲的世界观、做出错误判断、甚至无意间传播谣言；而年轻人批判性思维尚未成熟，故对耸动却无据的信息格外没有抵抗力。这一点为『需要对策』提供理由。
分主体给对策：第三个要点：给出 2-3 条可落地的对策，且每条都有明确主体和具体做法——学校开设媒介素养课教学生核查事实、平台加强事实核查并标注可疑内容、个人养成多源交叉验证的习惯。这一点直接兑现 Directions 的 suggest measures to address the issue。
facts: 核心任务｜评现象＋提对策：题目要求一篇作文里同时完成两件事：comment on the phenomenon described in the passage and suggest measures to address the issue。现象是给定 passage 说的——Young people spend a lot of time on the Internet，却常常unable to recognize false information on the Internet, judge the reliability of online information sources, or tell real news stories from fake ones。所以本题必须钉死：先评论『年轻人辨不清网络虚假信息』这一现象（它为何值得担忧），再给出解决它的具体办法，两者缺一不可。
读者 · 语域｜面向阅卷人的正式议论文：本题要求write an essay，是一篇没有具体收信人的议论文，不需要称呼语和落款。读者就是阅卷老师，语域用正式书面语即可：不用缩写（用 do not 而非 don't）、不用口语感叹、多用第三人称和被动式（measures should be taken），全篇保持客观评论的口吻。
中心立意｜辨假能力缺失须多方共治：本篇中心立场：年轻人虽长时间上网却缺乏辨别网络虚假信息的能力，这是一个不容忽视、须由学校、平台与个人共同应对的问题。这一句同时呼应了 Directions 要求的『评现象』（点明它是问题）与『提对策』（暗示多方共治的方向），把两个任务拧成一根主线。
rubric: 内容切题｜双任务都要落地：本题必须同时comment on the phenomenon described in the passage and suggest measures to address the issue，且现象须紧扣 Young people spend a lot of time on the Internet 的辨假困境；最易失分是只评现象不给对策，或跑去泛谈上网利弊。
结构连贯｜三段边界清晰：本题按『现象评论—危害分析—对策』三段推进，段首过渡句和第三段的 First and foremost / Meanwhile / Finally 让评论与对策两大任务边界分明，阅卷人一眼能看出两件事都做了。
语言准确｜同义改写显功力：本题范文把原文 tell real news stories from fake ones 改写为 distinguish real news from fake stories，这类同义改写正是六级作文语言分的加分点；反之逐字抄材料、reliability 拼错、news 当复数用，都会拉低语言分。
字数格式｜卡进硬性区间：Directions 明确write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words，是硬性上下限，两头都不能碰线；写太短缺论证、太长拖沓都要扣分，三段各写透即可自然落在区间内。
pitfalls: 只诉现象不给药方：反面示例：通篇写 Young people are addicted to the Internet and believe everything they see. This is really terrible and dangerous… 从头到尾只渲染现象可怕，一条对策都没有。修正：删掉一半渲染，补上一段具体对策，如 To tackle this, schools should offer media-literacy courses and platforms should label questionable content.

跑去谈上网利弊：反面示例：The Internet has both advantages and disadvantages. It brings convenience but wastes our time and harms our health… 这是万能网络利弊模板，完全偏离辨假主题。修正：紧扣主题写 Many young people cannot tell whether online information is true or reliable, which may mislead their judgement.

空喊口号无落点：反面示例：We should improve ourselves and pay more attention to this problem. The society should also do something. 主体模糊、动作空洞，阅卷人看不到任何可落地的办法。修正：Schools should teach students to verify facts, and platforms should clearly label questionable content.

同义反复凑字数：反面示例：This problem is very serious. It is really a serious problem. We must take it seriously because it is serious. 三句说同一件事，纯注水。修正：把重复删掉，替换成一个后果 Misled by fake news, young people may make ill-informed decisions.
model: It has become a common phenomenon that young people spend a great deal of time online, yet many of them struggle to tell trustworthy information from falsehood. As the passage notes, they are often unable to recognize false information, judge the reliability of online sources, or distinguish real news from fake stories. This deficiency in digital judgment, though easily overlooked, deserves our serious attention.

The consequences are far from trivial. Misled by fabricated news, young people may form distorted views of the world, make ill-informed decisions, and even spread rumours unknowingly. Since their critical-thinking skills are still developing, they are especially vulnerable to eye-catching yet groundless claims that circulate rapidly across social media.

To address this issue, concerted efforts are needed. First and foremost, schools should offer media-literacy courses that teach students how to verify facts and trace information back to its source. Meanwhile, online platforms ought to strengthen fact-checking and clearly label questionable content. Finally, young people themselves should cultivate the habit of cross-checking a story against several reliable sources before believing or sharing it. Only in this way can they navigate the digital world wisely.
modelTranslation: 如今出现了一个普遍现象：年轻人花大量时间上网，却有许多人难以把可信的信息与虚假信息区分开来。正如材料所指出的，他们常常无法识别虚假信息、判断网络信息来源的可靠性，也分不清真假新闻。这种数字辨别力的缺失虽易被忽视，却值得我们严肃对待。
其后果绝非微不足道。被伪造的新闻误导，年轻人可能形成扭曲的世界观、做出草率的决定，甚至在不知情中传播谣言。由于他们的批判性思维尚在发育，对那些耸人听闻却毫无依据、在社交媒体上迅速扩散的说法格外缺乏抵抗力。
要应对这一问题，需要多方合力。首先，学校应开设媒介素养课程，教学生如何核查事实、追溯信息来源。与此同时，网络平台应加强事实核查，并对可疑内容作出明确标注。最后，年轻人自己应养成一个习惯：在相信或转发之前，用若干个可靠来源交叉核对同一条消息。唯有如此，他们才能明智地在数字世界中航行。
breakdown: 第 1 段｜现象＋复述＋评论：。本段落实了『先复述现象再点危害』：It has become a common phenomenon that… 是现象引入句；As the passage notes… 把材料里的辨假困境改写复述进来（把原文 tell real news stories from fake ones 改写成 distinguish real news from fake stories，避免逐字照抄）；末句 This deficiency… deserves our serious attention 亮出态度，完成 comment 这半个任务。

第 2 段｜后果＋成因：。本段落实『追问影响做因果分析』：The consequences are far from trivial 是后果总起句；Misled by fabricated news, young people may… 用一串动词铺开多重危害；Since their critical-thinking skills are still developing… 用 Since 引出成因，说明为何年轻人格外脆弱，为下段对策提供理由。

第 3 段｜三主体分点对策：。本段落实『对策落到主体加做法』：To address this issue, concerted efforts are needed 引出对策；First and foremost / Meanwhile / Finally 三个信号词分点，每点都是『主体＋具体做法』——schools offer media-literacy courses、platforms strengthen fact-checking and label content、young people cross-check sources；末句 Only in this way can they navigate the digital world wisely 用倒装升华收尾。
prompts.paperTitle: 2021 年 12 月六级翻译与写作第 1 套

prompts.label: Part I · 写作
directions: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay related to the short passage given below. In your essay, you are to comment on the phenomenon described in the passage and suggest measures to address the issue. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words. Nowadays star chasing is prevalent among many teenagers. They take pop stars as their idols, imitating their way of talking, following their style of dressing9 and seeking every chance to meet them in person at great expenses.
prompts.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay related to the short passage given below. In your essay, you are to comment on the phenomenon described in the passage and suggest measures to address the issue. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words. Nowadays star chasing is prevalent among many teenagers. They take pop stars as their idols, imitating their way of talking, following their style of dressing9 and seeking every chance to meet them in person at great expenses.
outline: 第 1 段｜复述现象＋亮立场：用一两句概括材料里 star chasing is prevalent among many teenagers 的现象，随即点出全文总立场：应辩证看待、理性追星。这一段承担开头与定调。
第 2 段｜辩证评价现象：本段完成 comment on the phenomenon 任务：先让步承认适度追星的正向激励，再转折指出过度追星在金钱、时间、学业上的危害，用因果与让步连接把逻辑铺开。
第 3 段｜提对策＋收束：本段完成 suggest measures to address the issue 任务：分主体（家长学校、媒体、青少年自身）给可落地建议，行文成段，末句收束呼应『理性追星』主旨。
points: 合理的一面：正向激励：把优秀的人 take pop stars as their idols 并非全是坏事：一位努力奋斗的偶像可以激励青少年追求自己的目标，这是追星积极的一面，先承认它，论证才不片面。
过度的危害：耗财误学：问题出在『过度』：像 seeking every chance to meet them in person at great expenses 这样不惜代价，会耗费青少年有限的金钱和时间、分散学业精力，甚至扭曲价值观。这是评价里最该展开的负面要点。
对策：多方引导理性观：落到 suggest measures to address the issue：家长和学校引导青少年树立理性偶像观，媒体多传播真正的榜样而非空洞名气，青少年自己学偶像的长处而不迷失自我。
facts: 核心任务｜评追星现象＋给对策：本篇要完成两件事缺一不可：一是对材料里的追星现象作出评价（表明你怎么看），二是针对它 suggest measures to address the issue。材料把现象讲得很具体—— star chasing is prevalent among many teenagers，青少年 take pop stars as their idols，还会 imitating their way of talking 并 seeking every chance to meet them in person at great expenses。你的作文就是围绕『该怎么看这件事＋该怎么办』来写。

读者 · 语域｜面向阅卷人的正式议论：本题没有具体收信人，是面向阅卷人的正式书面议论文，用第一人称表达立场（In my view / I believe）即可，无需称呼语和署名。语域保持正式：少用口语缩略和感叹，多用完整的因果、让步连接。这一点对应要求里的 write an essay related to the short passage given below——写的是 essay（论说文），不是私人信件。
中心立意｜理性追星，不盲目：中心立场一句话：对 star chasing is prevalent among many teenagers 这一现象应辩证看待——适度欣赏偶像可以是正能量，但盲目过度则弊大于利，关键在于引导青少年理性追星。这样立意既回应了『评价』任务，又为后面的『对策』留好了出口。
rubric: 内容切题｜双任务都要落段：本题要求 comment on the phenomenon described in the passage and suggest measures to address the issue 两件事：第二段承载评价、第三段承载对策，缺一即失分。核对时确认两段都实打实写到，且评价是辩证的、对策是可落地的。
结构连贯｜让步转折要显性：本题评价段是辩证的，尤其要让『先承认后批评』的转折显性化（Admittedly…However…），否则两种态度混在一起会显得自相矛盾。三段之间也要有『现象—评价—对策』的推进感。
语言准确｜追星用词要地道：本题高频词要用对：追星 star chasing / idol worship，偶像 idol，崇拜 worship，不惜代价 at great expense，理性的 rational。避免把『追星』直译成 chase stars 之外的生造搭配，让步转折句式确保连词后成分完整。
字数格式｜守住上下限：本题硬性要求 You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words，是有上限的区间，超 200 或不足 150 都扣分。三段式正好把篇幅稳在区间中段，别因展开对策而写超。
pitfalls: 只评不给对策：反面：通篇只写『追星浪费钱、耽误学习、非常糟糕』，从头骂到尾，却没有一句怎么办。修正：必须补出对策段，例如『Parents and schools should guide adolescents to build a rational view of idols.』把 suggest measures 这半补齐。

整句搬材料：反面：开头直接抄『They take pop stars as their idols, imitating their way of talking, following their style of dressing…』一长串充字数。修正：改写成一句概括——『Many teenagers today are obsessed with pop stars, copying how their idols talk and dress.』

全盘否定追星：反面：『Star chasing is completely wrong and harmful, and all fans are foolish.』一棍子打死、还带人身攻击。修正：先让步——『Admittedly, taking an admirable star as one's idol can be positively motivating』，再转折批评过度，态度才辩证。
model: The passage vividly presents a common scene: many teenagers today are obsessed with pop stars, copying how their idols talk and dress and spending heavily just to see them face to face. In my view, this phenomenon deserves a balanced judgement rather than blind praise or total denial.

Admittedly, taking an admirable star as one's idol can be positively motivating, since a hard-working singer may inspire young people to pursue their own dreams. However, when admiration turns into blind worship, the harm outweighs the benefit. Chasing stars at great expense drains teenagers' limited money and time, distracts them from their studies, and may even distort their values.

To address the issue, joint efforts are needed. Parents and schools should guide adolescents to build a rational view of idols, while the media ought to promote genuine role models instead of empty fame. For teenagers themselves, the key is to learn from a star's strengths without losing themselves. Only in this way can idol worship become a source of growth rather than regret.
modelTranslation: 这段材料生动地呈现了一个常见场景：如今许多青少年沉迷于流行明星，模仿偶像说话和穿着的方式，甚至一掷千金只为与他们当面相见。在我看来，这一现象值得辩证看待，而非盲目吹捧或全盘否定。
诚然，把一位优秀的明星当作偶像可以带来正向激励，因为一位勤奋的歌手也许会激励年轻人去追逐自己的梦想。然而，一旦欣赏变成盲目崇拜，弊便会大于利。不惜重金追星会耗尽青少年有限的金钱和时间，分散他们的学业精力，甚至可能扭曲他们的价值观。
为解决这一问题，需要多方共同努力。家长和学校应引导青少年树立理性的偶像观，媒体则应多传播真正的榜样而非空洞的名气。对青少年自身而言，关键是学习明星的长处而不迷失自我。唯有如此，偶像崇拜才能成为成长的源泉，而非遗憾。
breakdown: 第 1 段｜概括＋亮立场：。首段用『The passage vividly presents a common scene』一句把材料现象浓缩改写（未照抄原句），紧接 『In my view, this phenomenon deserves a balanced judgement rather than blind praise or total denial』亮出辩证总立场，落实了第一段『复述现象＋亮立场』的功能与『概括不照抄』方法。

第 2 段｜让步转折评价：。本段用 『Admittedly…can be positively motivating』让步承认正面，再以 『However, when admiration turns into blind worship, the harm outweighs the benefit』转折，随后 『drains…, distracts…, and may even distort…』并列铺开危害，完成 comment on the phenomenon，兑现『让步后转折』方法。

第 3 段｜分主体对策收尾：。本段以 『joint efforts are needed』总起，按 『Parents and schools…, while the media…』『For teenagers themselves…』分主体给建议，末句 『Only in this way can idol worship become a source of growth rather than regret』收束，完成 suggest measures to address the issue 并呼应主旨。
prompts.paperTitle: 2021 年 12 月六级翻译与写作第 2 套

prompts.label: Part I · 写作
directions: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay related to the short passage given below. In your essay, you are to comment on the phenomenon described in the passage and suggest measures to address the issue. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words. Some parents in China are overprotective of their children. They plan everything for their children, make all the decisions for them, and do not allow them to explore on their own in case they make mistakes or get hurt.
prompts.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay related to the short passage given below. In your essay, you are to comment on the phenomenon described in the passage and suggest measures to address the issue. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words. Some parents in China are overprotective of their children. They plan everything for their children, make all the decisions for them, and do not allow them to explore on their own in case they make mistakes or get hurt.
outline: 第 1 段｜转述现象＋亮态度：用一两句把短文里 Some parents in China are overprotective of their children 的现象概括转述，随即表明立场：这种做法弊大于利。
第 2 段｜分析危害：分两层说清过度保护的坏处：剥夺独立能力、削弱抗挫力，并用一句因果收束，指出它如何影响孩子长远成长。
第 3 段｜给出对策：针对危害提出具体可操作的解决办法，分点推进，收束全篇。
points: 危害一·剥夺独立能力：第一条要点：家长 make all the decisions for them，孩子从没机会自己权衡、自己解决问题，独立决策与生活自理能力就长不出来。
危害二·缺乏抗挫力：第二条要点：家长 do not allow them to explore on their own in case they make mistakes or get hurt，把孩子隔绝在一切失败之外，反而使他们经不起挫折、遇挫就垮。
对策·放手＋容错＋由管到导：第三块（对策）针对上面两条反着提：放手让孩子做力所能及的决定、把犯错当成学习机会、家长从掌控者转为引导陪伴者。三条都具体可操作，正好收束全篇。
facts: 核心任务｜评现象＋提对策：本题的核心任务被一句话钉死：comment on the phenomenon described in the passage and suggest measures to address the issue。现象就是短文里的家长过度保护——They plan everything for their children, make all the decisions for them, and do not allow them to explore on their own in case they make mistakes or get hurt。所以你要写的是：先表态这种现象好不好，再给出能落地的解决办法。
读者 · 语域｜面向阅卷人的正式议论文：本题要求写的是 an essay related to the short passage given below，没有指定收信人、也不用称呼和落款，读者就是阅卷老师。因此用第三人称为主的正式书面语即可，态度可以有'我认为'（In my view），但不要口语缩写、不要写成给某人的信。六级这类现象类作文都属这一路，语域上求稳、求清楚，不必花哨。
中心立意｜过度保护弊大于利：全篇中心立场一句话：家长出于爱的过度保护，即 make all the decisions for them, and do not allow them to explore on their own，本意虽好却弊大于利，会拖累孩子的成长，必须改变。整篇的评论段和对策段都围绕这条立场展开。
rubric: 内容切题｜两块都要且对准现象：本题必须同时完成 comment on the phenomenon described in the passage and suggest measures to address the issue，评论和对策都要扣住'家长过度保护、包办决定、不许试错'，跑到别的话题就偏了。
结构连贯｜三段各司其职＋逻辑词到位：本题三段分别承担转述亮态度、分析危害、给对策，段间靠让步（however）与因果（as a result）衔接，把'本意好但方式害人'的逻辑讲通，读起来才连贯。
语言准确｜现在时＋复数一致：本题讲的是普遍现象，通篇用一般现在时；children、parents 是复数，动词别漏。适当用 well-intentioned、resilience 等词能加分，但先保证不出低级错。
字数格式｜卡在150到200之间：本题硬性要求 You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words，低于 150 或高于 200 都算违规；转述现象一句带过，把篇幅留给危害与对策。
pitfalls: 只批评不给对策：反面示例：通篇都在说'家长过度保护害了孩子、剥夺了独立、削弱了抗挫力……'，结尾一句'这种现象令人担忧'就收了，全程没提任何解决办法。改法：删掉一部分重复的批评，专门加一段对策（放手让孩子自己决定、允许犯错、家长转为引导者），把 suggest measures 补齐。

整句搬原文凑数：反面示例：正文开头直接抄 'Some parents in China are overprotective of their children. They plan everything for their children, make all the decisions for them...'。改法：换成自己的概括——'It is not uncommon nowadays that some parents arrange everything and forbid any independent exploration for their children.'，省下的词用来展开危害。

空喊家长应改变：反面示例：'To solve this problem, parents should change their ideas and pay more attention to their children.' 空泛无内容。改法：'Parents should let their children make age-appropriate decisions and treat mistakes as lessons rather than disasters.'，把'改变观念'落成具体做法。
model: It is not uncommon nowadays that some parents in China are overprotective of their children. They arrange everything, make every decision on their behalf, and forbid any independent exploration for fear of mistakes or injuries. In my view, however well-intentioned this practice may be, it does far more harm than good.

To begin with, such excessive protection deprives children of the chance to develop independence. When every choice is made for them, they never learn how to weigh options or solve problems on their own. Moreover, being shielded from all failure leaves them without resilience; a child who has never fallen simply does not know how to stand up again. As a result, these children may grow into adults who are competent in theory yet helpless in real life.

To address this issue, parents should first loosen their grip and let children make age-appropriate decisions by themselves. In addition, they ought to treat mistakes as valuable lessons rather than disasters to be avoided at all costs. Ultimately, the wisest parents shift their role from controllers to guides, offering support from behind instead of clearing every obstacle ahead.
modelTranslation: 如今，中国一些家长对孩子过度保护的现象并不少见。他们替孩子安排好一切，代其做出每一个决定，还因为怕孩子犯错或受伤而禁止任何独立探索。在我看来，这种做法无论初衷多么美好，都是弊大于利的。
首先，这种过度保护剥夺了孩子发展独立能力的机会。当所有选择都由别人替他们做时，他们永远学不会自己权衡利弊、自己解决问题。此外，把孩子隔绝在一切失败之外，会让他们缺乏抗挫力；一个从未跌倒过的孩子，根本不知道该如何重新站起来。结果，这些孩子可能长成理论上很能干、现实生活中却手足无措的成年人。
为解决这一问题，家长首先应当松开双手，让孩子自己去做力所能及的决定。此外，他们应把犯错当作宝贵的一课，而不是不惜一切代价要避开的灾难。归根结底，最明智的家长会把自己的角色从掌控者转为引导者，在孩子身后给予支持，而不是替他们扫清前方的每一个障碍。
breakdown: 第 1 段｜转述加让步亮态度：。首段先用 It is not uncommon nowadays that... 把现象概括转述（arrange everything, make every decision, forbid any independent exploration），没有照抄原句；再用 however well-intentioned this practice may be, it does far more harm than good 一句让步转折亮明弊大于利的立场，落实了 outline 第 1 段'转述现象＋亮态度'的功能。
第 2 段｜两条危害加因果收束：。本段用 To begin with 领出'剥夺独立'、用 Moreover 递进到'缺乏抗挫力'，最后 As a result 收一句 competent in theory yet helpless in real life，把两条危害的后果拧成一股，正是 paragraphGuide 第 2 段'层层递进加因果收束'的落地。

第 3 段｜三条落地对策：。本段 To address this issue 呼应任务动词，给出 loosen their grip and let children make age-appropriate decisions、treat mistakes as valuable lessons、shift their role from controllers to guides 三条具体做法，每条都是可操作动作而非口号，达成 outline 第 3 段'给出对策'的功能。
